item.title: BATTLE BEAST Announce Line-Up Change And Welcome New Vocalist Marina La Torraca
item.description: BATTLE BEAST have announced that long-time vocalist Noora Louhimo will be departing the band. The news was shared on the band’s official social media channels yesterday.While the band bids farewell to a defining voice in its history, BATTLE BEAST are equally thrilled to introduce their new singer: Marina La Torraca.
